mpsrf_method: MPSRF/PSRF follow the group's MATLAB convention (brho/mpsrf.py, getMSPRF / computeMPSRFcurve). Samples: the chain state saved every 80 iterations. The window STARTS at iteration 0 of the run (of the phase, for the second phase of experiment 5), i.e. the adaptation period is NOT discarded, and GROWS to the end of the run: at curve point u it holds the saved samples from the start iteration to the current iteration, every 2-th sample (skip 2), with a curve point every 15 saved samples (1200 iterations). For each window, with m chains and n samples per chain: W = mean over chains of the within-chain covariance (divisor n-1), B/n = covariance of the m chain means (divisor m-1), MPSRF = sqrt((n-1)/n + (m+1)/m * lambda_max(W^-1 B/n)); the per-component PSRF_i = sqrt(V_ii / W_ii) with V = (n-1)/n W + (m+1)/m B/n, and the reported PSRF is max_i PSRF_i. 'convergence_iteration' = first curve point (ignoring the first 10 points) with MPSRF < 1.2, linearly interpolated (with --mpsrf-log: curve points log-spaced, no points ignored, and 'stays_below_from_iteration' = first point after the last one at or above 1.2). The x axis is the iteration of the last sample in the window. Not split-chain, no extra burn-in. Dimension: theta (64), or the 58 range coordinates V_+^T theta for runs whose theta lives in the rank-58 range; local coefficients as stated per entry.
